This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. M.K. Mohapatra, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Mr. S. Nayak,
learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for the State-opposite parties.
3.

The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties to extend all the benefits available under the Orissa Resettlement and Rehabilitation Policy, 2006 for acquisition of his land and building for construction of Lower Suktel Irrigation Project, Balangir and further to issue direction to opposite party no.3-Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lower Suktel Irrigation Project, Balangir to refer the matter to the civil court under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act for redetermination of compensation amount for the acquired land involved in Khata No.44 of mouza-Pardhiapali in the district of Balangir under Annexure-1 within a stipulated period.

4. Opposite parties no.2 & 3 have filed counter affidavit, paragraph-6 whereof reads as follows:
"6.

That, in reply to the averment made in Paragraph-4 of the writ application, it is humbly submitted that, the petitioner is one of the co-sharer of khata No.44 of village-Pardhiapali having total area of Ac 12.70 decimal land.
The petitioner share is Ac. 6.35 decimal.
He has received the compensation amount under protest.
The matter is referred to the Hon'ble court of civil Judge under section 18 for re-determinations of the market value vide Letter No.659 dated 28.07.2017.
Copy of letter dated 28.07.2017 is annexed herewith as Annexure- A/3."

5. In view of the above, the relief sought with regard to referring the matter to the civil court has been granted to the petitioner and so far as relief for extension of all the benefits available under the Lingaraj Gadtya vs State Of Odisha & Ors.
